goal: Accumulate legitimate, useful Ace activity before the deadline without spam or artificial volume.

approvalBatchShape.inputScope: public-safe synthetic or public web context only
hardStops: stop if service asks for sensitive data
stop if cost exceeds approved cap
stop if payment route differs from approved route
stop if output would expose private data

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Find and summarize where a small service business loses inbound leads.
candidateRuns.publicSafeInput: Generic lead form and response-delay scenario. No real customer data.
candidateRuns.deliverable: One-page handoff leak diagnosis and automation checkpoint.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Research common contractor follow-up gaps and convert them into a paid micro-audit angle.
candidateRuns.publicSafeInput: Public search terms about contractor lead follow-up and generic workflow notes.
candidateRuns.deliverable: Micro-offer wedge, proof points, and buyer objections.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Turn a messy dispatch intake pattern into a structured triage checklist.
candidateRuns.publicSafeInput: Synthetic dispatch scenario with no company/customer identifiers.
candidateRuns.deliverable: Dispatch intake triage checklist and escalation rule.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Explain x402/SAP payment proof to a nontechnical buyer.
candidateRuns.publicSafeInput: Public bounty context and no private account data.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Estimate ROI of reducing first-response time in a generic small business.
candidateRuns.publicSafeInput: Generic assumptions and public search context only.
candidateRuns.deliverable: ROI sketch with assumptions and caveats.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Scan public examples of AI agent workflow demos and identify what judges can verify quickly.
candidateRuns.deliverable: Judge-readability checklist for our own proof package.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Generate a public FAQ for Pablito Settlement Sentinel without overclaims.
candidateRuns.publicSafeInput: Current proof files and public-safe project summary.
candidateRuns.deliverable: FAQ with proof boundaries and no reward claims.

candidateRuns.workflowNeed: Convert raw proof artifacts into a concise reviewer receipt.
candidateRuns.deliverable: Reviewer receipt with service ids, timestamps, and hashes.
